criteria.requirement: Repair load() for standard binary streams by decoding before format detection, using the requested encoding from the current cursor. Extend dump() to io.BufferedIOBase/io.RawIOBase including BytesIO and real wb files, encoding exactly once; text streams receive str and paths retain their existing explicit encoding behavior. Do not catch TypeError to retry writes; do not rewind, truncate or close caller-owned streams. Decode/encode/write errors propagate. Roundtrip leading-blank TOML, compact JSON and reserved business metadata from prior deliveries without losing the handler or Unicode content.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
